family_content_hash_meaning: No standalone family document exists: SHA-256 of ContractJSON.bytes(sorted member IdentityObservation array). Semantic hash separately binds actual target, split, and member IDs.
fingerprint: SHA-256 of ContractJSON.bytes(SemanticBasis): sorted-key UTF-8 JSON without slash escaping, snake_case keys, version/kind/fields/sets. Sets sorted lexicographically; text exact, no normalization. Issuance key is pilot-230:existing-registration-v1:<kind>:<semantic fingerprint>.
ledger_revision_meaning: 1 = first registration in this ledger on adoption date, NOT original document revision or invented past issuance. Each observation binds the actual content revision and sealed hash seen now. Earlier 290 records/events are not revised or reinterpreted.
